# Quote an editing job: flat fee, per-word rate, and what happens if the manuscript is slower than you thought

> Free quote calculator for freelance editors and proofreaders: word count, level of edit and your hourly target become a flat fee, a per-word rate, the days the job needs and what the fee pays if you edit slower than planned. Private, runs in your browser.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
